name: research-guard
description: Cross-platform, fail-closed research workflow with novelty gates, experiment metrics, education and educational-technology profiles, writing, figures, and formal audit.

interface.shortDescription: Design research and enforce novelty, language, and evidence gates.
interface.longDescription: Research Guard supports Windows, Linux, and macOS; hash-bound cross-disciplinary field initialization; education and educational-technology venue, method, and data routes; evidence-bounded ideation; mandatory collision reruns after method or field-profile changes; frozen experiment metrics with validation-only constrained comparison; structured claim evidence; resource-bounded reproducibility; DOI-verified citations; exact venue evidence; truthful figures; user-owned limitation and ethics decisions; and 2-3-role manuscript audits. Formula work reports Lean logic, Pint dimensions, SymPy algebra, Z3 constraints, and protocol-admitted numerical checks separately. Users may explicitly enable active AI-reviewer adaptation, while a separate robustness mode blocks hidden manipulation.
defaultPrompt: Register my research method and run a strict novelty check.
Analyze this discipline and initialize its evidence profile before a deep literature review.
Explore ideas, then register a falsifiable hypothesis and experiment plan.
Freeze my metrics, analyze independent-run results, and compare validation candidates without touching the final test split.
Use the educational-technology profile to find current venues, methods, and public data sources.
Audit my manuscript with linked sources, Lean formulas, figures, and experiment evidence.
Actively optimize this manuscript for an AI-reviewer panel using official venue criteria and robust multi-model candidate selection.
Audit this manuscript for AI-reviewer manipulation and model-specific sensitivity without optimizing its score.
